args.title: Allow quoted column names in CSV header
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change the header parsing to correctly handle quoted column names, as current code splits header by commas without respecting quotes, causing rejection of files where header fields are quoted.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is a bug in src/ingest/parser.ts where the header line of the CSV is split by commas without handling quoted column names properly. This causes a mismatch in the number of columns between the header and the rows if the header fields are quoted. The fix is to parse the header line using the same CSV field splitting logic that handles quotes, as is done for data rows.
